items.title: Samsung Fixes Critical Zero-Day CVE-2025-21043 Exploited in Android Attacks
items.description: Samsung has released its monthly security updates for Android, including a fix for a security vulnerability that it said has been exploited in zero-day attacks. The vulnerability, CVE-2025-21043 (CVSS score: 8.8), concerns an out-of-bounds write that could result in arbitrary code execution.
